# XMarks — Privacy-First "Second Brain for X" (Twitter)

> XMarks is a 100% local-first Chrome extension that transforms X's chaotic native bookmark list into an organized, searchable personal reference library with offline AI auto-categorization.

## Key Features
- **1-Click Native Sync**: Automatically imports and indexes bookmarks directly from x.com/i/bookmarks.
- **On-Device Local AI**: Uses Hugging Face Transformers.js (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) directly inside browser IndexedDB — 0 cloud servers, 100% privacy.
- **Instant Full-Text Search**: Search bookmark copy, author handles, notes, and article snippets.
- **Custom Categories & Tags**: Color-coded category tags and custom notes.
- **Native X Overrides**: Replaces or augments X's native bookmark button in the timeline.
- **Offline Backup**: Export and import library backups as JSON files anytime.

## Technical Specifications
- **Platform**: Google Chrome / Chromium-based browsers (Manifest V3)
- **Architecture**: Local-First IndexedDB + Service Worker + Transformers.js WebAssembly
- **License**: MIT Open Source
- **Repository**: https://github.com/YarooqH/twtbk
